text:
alex: Heads up — we tried to scale the new GPU nodepool in us-west-2 and hit ENI/secondary IP limits. Nodes fail to come up after ~120 instances.
mira: Can you paste the error logs? Looks like ENI allocation or OOM on attachment? :thinking_face:
alex: From kubelet logs: 
```
Failed to allocate IPv4 secondary addresses from eni eni-0abc123: insufficient ip addresses
```
We are using CNI mode that assigns one secondary IP per pod; target is ~300 pods per AZ across 3 AZs, so need a lot more secondary IPs and ENIs per account.
cody: Current account quotas in us-west-2: ENIs per region = 3500, IPs per ENI = 10, Elastic IPs = 100. We're exceeding per-ENI secondary IP headroom and overall private IP available for the VPC CIDR.
alex: Opening a bounded request to AWS: increase ENIs to 7000, increase IPv4 addresses per VPC? Also request bump for Elastic IPs to 500 for canary public endpoints. Any objections?
mira: Two notes: 1) We should ask for "per ENI IPv4 addresses" or request larger instance-types MTU? 2) Consider enabling IPv6 / dual-stack on the VPC to reduce EIP count and public IPv4 consumption.
alex: Agreed — I will request dual-stack enablement for the VPC and ask for larger ENI quota. Draft ticket text: 
"We're Redwood Inference, account 987654321000. Requesting ENI quota increase to 7000 in us-west-2 and Elastic IP limit increase to 500. Additionally request assistance enabling IPv6 dual-stack on VPC vpc-0f9e1a and guidance to migrate service endpoints to IPv6 where possible to reduce IPv4 EIP usage. We anticipate scaling to ~1k GPU instances over next quarter. Case urgency: medium (prod impact during scale)." 
Thoughts?
cody: Add note about hitting secondary private IP addresses per ENI (we currently use CNI: aws-vpc with warm-ip-targets). Ask them to raise "IPv4 addresses per network interface" if available.
mira: Also include request to raise route table target limits? When we move to dual-stack we may need additional route entries for ephemeral NAT gateways. Ask for support to move NAT to egress-only internet gateway for IPv6.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: New support case created: 2026-03-02T14:23:44Z -> AWS Case #1234567891 (quota increase, VPC IPv6 enablement) :white_check_mark:
aws-support: Hi team — we've created a quota request for ENIs and Elastic IPs in us-west-2. ENI quota request submitted as Q-98765, EIP increase submitted as Q-98766. Enabling IPv6 dual-stack requires an account-level opt-in and may require re-creating the VPC if the CIDR was custom. We'll follow up with step-by-step migration guidance.
alex: Thanks — please post the AWS case links and ETA here when available. Also would like a fallback plan: if IPv6 opt-in takes >2 weeks, we need temporary increase to EIP + secondary IPs to complete scale-out this week.
aws-support: Understood. Temporary increase approved for EIPs to 300 while we process the larger request. ETA 48 hours. ENI quota Q-98765 is in review; estimated decision 3-5 business days. We'll update with any blockers.
mira: For tracking: assigning to cloud-ops runbook task #INF-842 to coordinate rollout and test IPv6 for internal-only endpoints first.
cody: Also adding a quick script to check available secondary IPs per ENI: 
```
aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region us-west-2 --query 'NetworkInterfaces[].{Id:NetworkInterfaceId,AvailableIps:PrivateIpAddresses | length(@)}'
```
We should run across AZs and estimate how many we can free by defragmenting secondary IP allocations.
alex: Great — mounting this as top priority for the weekend scale test. Will paste case numbers here when I get the AWS links. :thumbsup:
